propositions: Existing deterministic repair, schema extraction, and sentinel selection in structured.parse_structured and structured.check_response must be wrapped in a Pydantic output-policy adapter without duplicating or modifying the core logic.

The adapter must express the parse+validate path as a Pydantic TextOutputFunc that raises ModelRetry(str(err)) on retryable StructuredOutputError, preserving the original Rebar error in the exception __cause__ chain for Pydantic AI's bounded retry.

Stop/refusal safety currently implemented in structured.check_response (reading response.finish_reason and provider_details) must move to an after_model_request capability hook that raises terminal UnretryableOutputError to abort after one model call without triggering Pydantic retry prompts.

The adapter in pai_output.py must not introduce new retry loops, provider selection logic, usage projection, or result persistence; it only exposes the existing pure parse_structured and check_response authorities through Pydantic seams.

A real Pydantic Agent wired with the adapter (output_type=TextOutput(fn), capabilities=[cap]) must return the expected typed object for valid and repairable responses while preserving historical deterministic selection behavior.

Retryable validation failures must preserve exact Rebar StructuredOutputError identity in ModelRetry.__cause__ and refusal responses must raise UnretryableOutputError with model-call count of 1 and no RetryPromptPart in messages.
